newsitem.title: USA: Cordex to explore in Chile.
newsitem.headline: Cordex to explore in Chile.

text.p: Cordex Petroleums Inc said it agreed with ENAP (Empresa National Del Petroleo) today signed an agreement to explore and develop a 950,000 acre block in the Austral Basin, Chile.

Cordex said ENAP will be the operator with 45 percent interest in the venture with CORDEX holding 55 percent interest. This block is located northeast of the Straits of Magellan, continuing north to the Argentinean border.
The acreage is on trend with recent Springhill and Tertiary discoveries made by Qunitana and Perez Compac in the Argentinean part of the Austral basin.
Several undeveloped and/or older shut-in discoveries are included within the venture area, Cordex noted.
Chief executive Ralph Wilkerson said "Cordex has been working on this venture for over two and one half years."
The contract term is 35 years with an initial exploration stage of four years. A complementary exploration stage of six years is possible with additional drilling commitments.

The initial stage is divided into three phases, Cordex said. The first is 1.5 years in which $400,000 will be spent by the venture evaluating geologic data and reprocessing selected seismic data. The second 1.5-year phase will consist of obtaining new data with a minimum expenditure of $2 million. The last phase is one year and requires the drilling of two wells. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
